articleTitle: Evaluation of Usability and Accessibility of Mobile Application for People with Disability: Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Usability evaluation is the evaluation of the product or system context of use, which is determined by the users, environment, tasks, and equipment. As the field of usability evaluation research has evolved, researchers have developed a variety of ways to apply the evaluation of usability methods. This systematic review aims to identify topics, trends, categories, methods and to answer research questions in the field of evaluation of usability between 2017 to 2021. Based on the data search, 15 related studies were selected for further identification. The analysis of the selected studies shows that seven topics are being the focus and trend topics, namely: Accessibility, Usability Evaluation, Information Architecture, User Research, User Interface, Web Analytics, and Content Strategy. Of the fourteen methods, five of the most widely used methods in the field of evaluation of usability were identified. The evaluation of usability studied shows that there is no standardized method or technique that is widely accepted by all utility evaluators. Therefore, usability evaluation in the field of user experience tries as optimally as possible in the selection of combination methods to produce a more optimal evaluation.

articleTitle: Application of Voting Based Approach on Deep Learning Algorithm for Lung Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: With the advent of the Deep learning era, an unprecedented change has come in the field of medical image analysis via CAD (Computer-Aided Diagnosis) [1]–[13] system. With feature extraction capability, Deep learning effectively performs the classification task and thus enhances the prediction of Medical images. CNN models like Dense net 121, Resnet-50, Alex net, Mobile Net, and Inceptionv3 have been used to identify lung disease, but no model was able to predict the particular class of illness with 100% accuracy. In this paper, we apply the voting method, which combines three models Dense net 121, Mobile Net, NasNet, and predictions are made on the basis of the majority of optimistic predictions. Our approach was found to improve the prediction of a particular class of lung disease like Bacterial Pneumonia, Covid, and Lung Opacity. Normal lungs are predicted with 100% accuracy with our approach.

articleTitle: New Normal Regulation with Face Recognition Technology Using AttendX for Student Attendance Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: In this new normal era, the community is directed to minimize activities and meet other people or goods. This is aimed at avoiding an increase in the number of the spread of the Covid-19 virus. Following the government directive, a study was conducted to facilitate one of the activities of students and educators, namely online attendance called AttendX. The way this system works is effortless. By just registering, the system can verify faces that have been registered for attendance. This application is designed with modern facial recognition technology that has developed rapidly, with this sophistication can make it easier to detect faces in structured parts such as the forehead, cheekbones, eyes, and even the nose. In compliance with the new normal regulations, the AttendX platform is designed to detect faces if the user is wearing a mask. Because of the convenience of online attendance using faces, this AttendX study resulted in a peak implementation with an accuracy rate of 99%. This shows that AttendX can be used to perform student attendance well.

articleTitle: Face Recognition based Artificial Intelligence With AttendX Technology for Student Attendance
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: AttendX is a platform that uses a facial recognition system to perform attendance. AttendX is a solution for attendance systems that exist in the scope of work or agency. AttendX can make attendance activities more efficient because of its features, making it easier for users to attend. To register AttendX, only use the face (left, right, front side, wearing a mask) and a brief bio of the person who registers. AttendX can verify the face of the user who has registered and is stored in the database. This application is designed with high-speed facial recognition technology. It can be used to solve the current problem, preventing the spread of the covid-19 virus, because AttendX can also recognize the user's face when wearing a mask. This study provides a real-world view of technological developments, significantly facilitating the use of facial recognition technology to complement those presented on the Internet, the latest face recognition and verification, and propose possible use cases for various applications. AttendXN et facial recognition function, the method used is ResNet and a hierarchical feedforward network to achieve the planned results.

articleTitle: SaaS Platform for Blockchain Based E-Document Authentication applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Technological developments are increasingly sophisticated where every day, these developments have directions and goals to make it easier for humans in all things. In society 5.0, technology is judged not only by its intelligence but also by its benefits in helping humans. In a company, documents are precious objects, so that various things are very concerning, such as ratification, storage, and sharing of documents. 2 (two) problems were identified, namely that many companies still use the manual method where documents must be printed to be ratified by meeting directly and conventionally storing printed documents, so it is considered ineffective and efficient. These problems can be overcome with a Software as a Service (SaaS)-based digital signature system with distributed Blockchain support, making it easier for companies to validate and store documents. By using the SDLC waterfall development method and six literature studies. Researchers hope that digital signatures make it easier for everyone to validate digitally without having to print documents and do not need to think about the validity of the digital documents so that they can be considered effective and efficient to facilitate work.

articleTitle: Prototype Health Monitoring For Quarantined Covid 19 Patients Based On The Internet Of Things (IoT)
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: The Covid-19 virus can be transmitted in various ways, including direct contact with sufferers, so that there are many cases of Covid-19 patients who die during self-isolation. The cause is lessened oxygen levels in the blood or a medical term called Happy Hypoxia. Under normal conditions, the value of oxygen levels in the blood ranges from 95-100% and abnormal conditions <95%, while the standard heart rate ranges from 60–100 beats per minute (BPM). In general, a person feels normal and healthy without realizing his blood when experiencing a lack of oxygen. Therefore, it is necessary to measure oxygen levels in the blood periodically. Pulse oximeters are already on the market. Not many people have it. The pulse oximeter does not have a remote check feature. In addition, the use of a pulse oximeter at home is still controlled directly by the officer manually so that it is possible to interact directly. This tool can display data such as room temperature, body temperature, oxygen level data (SP02), and heart rate (BPM) of the patient. The device can work properly by sending patient health data remotely in real-time. So this research can help medics analyze and take action quickly. From the results of testing oxygen levels, the average error value is 0.01 or 1%. This value is still within the tolerance limit. So can use this tool to assist media workers in analyzing patient conditions remotely and making decisions about giving treatment to patients.

articleTitle: Public Sentiment on User Reviews about Application in Handling COVID-19 using Naive Bayes Method and Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Another crisis has emerged in the shape of widespread anxiety and panic, fueled by imprecise and frequently incorrect information, during the Coronavirus pandemic. As a result, there is a critical need to address and better comprehend COVID-19's informational crisis, as well as evaluate public mood, in order to adopt effective communications and policy decisions. This study aims to classify the results of PIKOBAR's review sentiments, PIKOBAR is a Center for Information and Coordination of Diseases and Disasters in West Java. A total of 371 reviews were taken, each of which was labeled positive, negative or neutral. The data first goes through a pre-processing process before conducting a sentiment review analysis using the Naive Bayes Classifier and Support Vector Machine processes. The results from 80% testing data and 20% training data obtained the Naive Bayes accuracy rate of 75.67% and the Support Vector Machine was 71.62%. Furthermore, in the text association process, information was obtained that the PIKOBAR application users mostly talked about words “Jabar” for positive class and the word “aplikasi” for negative class and the word “data” for neutral class.

articleTitle: Classification of Multi-Labeled Text Articles with Reuters Dataset using SVM
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: In text mining problems, text classification is one of the common tasks. Several real-world document classification involves imbalanced text data. This research investigates the behavior of Support Vector Machines classifiers on textual news data. The set of features is developed using the Count Vectorizer and Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency to train and test the model. We have observed the quality of the SVM classification algorithm with both linear and polynomial kernel on benchmark UCI News datasets: Reuters. The result shows that SVM with linear performs better and achieves 94.10% accuracy where SVM with polynomial kernel achieves 93.28% accuracy on the benchmark dataset.

articleTitle: A Preliminary Comparative Study on the Feasibility of a Multipurpose Numerical Weather Model for Prediction of Cumulonimbus Clouds in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Prediction of cumulonimbus (Cb) clouds in Indonesia is a necessity for civil aviation operations. The ability comparison of numerical weather prediction (NWP) multimodel to predict Cb clouds in order to obtain the best model was investigated in this study. NWP models used in this research were Australian Community Climate and Earth-System Simulator (ACCESS), Integrated Forecast System High Resolution (IFS HRES), Icosahedral Nonhydrostatic (ICON), Weather Research Forecast-Central Information and Processing System (WRF-CIPS), and Weather Research Forecast-Indonesia NWP (WRF-INA) whose performance is tested by calculating the probability of detection (POD), probability of false detection (1-POFD) and proportion correct (PC). The results show that the IFS HRES model is the best model compared to other models. For further studies, the research should be conducted at another time that has a different Cb cloud frequency distribution from this study.

articleTitle: A Systematic Literature Review: Image Segmentation on Brain MRI Image to Detect Brain Tumor
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Computer Vision has played a crucial role in multiple fields of work including in medical applications. Some of these applications can be found in brain tumor detection. Early detection of brain tumors is highly important in terms of improving the patient's chance of survival. Magnetic Resonance Image (MRI) has been the go-to solution in terms of detecting brain tumors. Even so, the methods used are still vastly reliant on multiple manual procedures which creates a potential human error. This is due to the high variety of human tissue that could look closely similar to some of the brain tumors. With the growth of computer vision, image segmentation has shown to be reliable and can aid medical experts in detecting brain tumors using the MRI image provided. In this paper, we will explore how image segmentation can be applied in brain tumor detection and how beneficial it can be in the medical field with the help of the Mathematical Morphological Reconstruction (MMR) algorithm.

articleTitle: Secure System Medical Record with Blockchain System: Recchain Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Medical records are very important and provide benefits that are felt by patients, doctors and other health workers in terms of clinical decision making. Seeing the importance of the presence of medical records, Indonesia has also implemented innovation in the use of technology in the application of digital medical records. However, until now there are still problems that occur in the application of the existing medical record technology which is centralized so it is still difficult to get the trust of patients. Therefore, in this case the research will have the object of research in storing medical record databases without the involvement of third parties. (Decentralized) So as a solution, this research will present a schematic system of architecture RecChain(Record Blockchain) with the advantages of being transparent and decentralized for the purpose of increasing patient trust in medical records with a decentralized and transparent database. In RecChain's research, it is not limited to decentralization, external provider medical record data, and smart contract networks. The results of the research obtained, the RecChain system can minimize data misuse, and the proposed scheme design will not depend on the Blockchain platform which makes the scheme have the potential for wider application in other health electronics to increase the tightness of system data protection.

articleTitle: Information Systems Maturity Level Assessment using the HISMM Framework: Case Study of State Hospital in Jakarta
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Efforts to deal with several risks have been regulated by law, which certain programs should be initiated by the organization especially for the prevention and control of patient care in the context of hospital management system. The availability of service facilities and medical equipment is important in handling Covid-19 patients as many drawbacks have been found due to new circumstances that many do not predict before, such as the allocation room and time management for separating the patients within treatment. Indeed, the shortcomings in managing the process often related to the utilization of technology infrastructure in containing patients' data and the medicine effectively. It is better to identify the issues resides in the hospital before coming up with the solution. Thus, this study want to assess the maturity level of the Information System using the Healthcare Information System Maturity Model (HISMM) as the framework. In the detail, to increase the flexibility of the environment for the sake of study, the investigation was conducted focusing on several attributes as a reference by analysing six dimensions that were relevant namely Data Analysis, Strategy, People, Electronic Medical Records, Information Security, and IT Infrastructure System. The results of this study indicated that State Hospital Jakarta has reached the maturity level at position 4 (four), which is equal to democratic cooperation. The recommendations given in this study are in the form of a roadmap that contains several steps in respected attributes that can support hospitals to reach the next level of maturity in the future.

articleTitle: Prediction of Study Period and Information on Judiciary in Higher Education Using the C5.0 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Data Mining is often used to find patterns with certain techniques. Many data mining has been exploited against academic data. In Data Mining, choosing the right method depends on the goal and the process. One method that is often used in data mining is a decision tree. The concept of a decision tree is to convert data into a decision tree. There are several algorithms in implementing decision trees, including the C5.0 algorithm. In previous studies, research has been carried out on the prediction of the study period, but only focused on one final label category, namely the study period. Although several studies have been carried out related to graduation predictions, the novelty of this study uses multi-label, namely the study period and the results of the graduation statement. The purpose of this study will focus on predicting the length of study and student graduation outcomes using the Decision tree method with the C5.0 Algorithm. After implementation, we tested the accuracy by dividing the test data and training data differently. The test is carried out using the r2 score. The accuracy results obtained are 73%, and suggestions for further research are to add leave attributes and organizational history which can be a factor in students not graduating on time.

articleTitle: Identifying Ranked Features through Optimized Selection Procedure towards Achieving Improved Accuracy in Diabetes Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: World Health Organization (WHO) reported in 2018, diabetes is a severe life-threatening illness, affecting 422 million people globally. Every year, the number of people affected rises significantly. For a medically significant outcome, early identification of diabetes is indeed preferred to prevent its severity. The goal of this paper is to use various data mining approaches to determine the probability of diabetes recurrence. The data for diabetes patients was obtained from the UCI machine learning repository's Pima Indians Diabetes dataset having a total of 9 attributes. Naive Bayes, Multilayer Perception, and JRip classification algorithms were used to evaluate the accuracy of their predictions on this dataset. The result of this experiment shows that using Ranker with these algorithms exhibit significant improvement in accuracy for diabetes detection. By removing certain lower-ranked features, it was possible to increase the accuracy for every model using an optimal feature selection approach. Not only do these features contribute very little, but their incorporation also causes classification systems to be misled. This helped the JRip, Multilayer Perceptron, and Naive Bayes algorithms achieve accuracy of 78.26%, 77.73%, and 77.47% respectively.

articleTitle: Strategic Location Based On the Availability of Public Facilities Using Multiple-Buffer
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Determining strategic location requires some considerations. One of them is to consider the availability of public facilities. This research will find out the strategic location in the East Jakarta area. Land Suitability Index suggests the strategic location can be regarded as from the availability of public facilities. The public facilities are health facilities, schools, public transportation, grocery, and restaurant. This research uses multiple ring buffers to create a map that shows the distance values of each public facility. The distance values will be shown in the form of multiple buffers, with the position of the public facility will be the center point of the buffer. The time needed to travel to the location will be the parameters for the multiple-ring buffers to create the buffers. From the datasets that have been put into the map and using the multiple ring buffers to show the distance values of the public facilities, this research finds out that several areas in East Jakarta can be considered the strategic location and not the strategic location. If there is a lot of buffer in the area, then the area can be regarded as a strategic location. Otherwise, if there is only a little or even no buffer in the area, then the area can be considered as a not strategic location. The research finds that area around Salemba Raya and Kayu Manis street, around Pahlawan Revolusi street, and around Bekasi Timur and Jendral Basuki Rahmat street are the strategic location. Meanwhile, the area around Naga Raya, Rawa Sumur, and between Otista street and Jagorawi highway are considered not strategic locations.

articleTitle: Cloud-Based Mixed Reality System in Machinery Vocational School: ICT Blueprint
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Education is always the most important part of our lives. To make education make a significant impact on today's learners, teaching and learning must evolve to match with today's learner's profile. Any education including vocational education has an important role in economic development and one of the ways to maximize the contribution of vocational educations is strengthening the link and match with the world of work [1]. As the technology also keeps evolving and it is getting more and more advanced, one technology that has significant traction lately is the mixed reality system and is often used for education purposes. Most big ICT companies like Microsoft, and HTC are racing to develop mixed reality systems to help the teaching and learning process to be more effective and efficient. Where everything is cloud-based, having a cloud-based mixed reality system is just makes sense but will have a great challenge and considered as a big ICT project. One of the ways to make the ICT project successful is to make a blueprint before it is started. The objective of this paper is how to develop an ICT Blueprint for implementing a cloud-based mixed reality system for machinery vocational schools to make the project have a higher success rate.

articleTitle: The Use of Bagging Technique to Optimize PSO Based C4.5 to Diagnose Diabetes
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Diabetes is one of the diseases with the highest number of sufferers worldwide. In addition, diabetes is in the top 10 leading causes of death and has been significantly increasing since 2000. If not treated quickly, diabetes will be very dangerous for the human organs, especially the parts of the body traversed by blood vessels. Therefore, this study aims to detect early stage diabetes. So that the treatment of diabetes is faster before it develops into a more serious direction. The begging technique on the PSO-based C4.5 algorithm is applied to determine the accuracy of this algorithm model in classifying people with diabetes. The bagging method and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) aim to address the weaknesses of the C4.5 algorithm in overlapping data, a large number of attributes, and classes. According to the experiments, the bagging technique on the PSO-based C4.5 algorithm produces a better accuracy value by approximately 95.58%, while the C4.5 algorithm ware 90.38%.

articleTitle: Analyzing sentiments on official online lending platform in Indonesia with a Combination of Naive Bayes and Lexicon Based Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: The rapid development of social media makes people write their opinions on something, and make the data source for this research one of them from social media, Twitter, which will be analyzed in the form of sentiment analysis which is a process to understand and process data to get the information contained. In the opinion of the sentence. The trend of legal online loan/credit applications widely used by people in Indonesia is a hot topic discussed by the public on Twitter. If you want to know the tendency of public comments on online loan/credit applications, whether positive or negative, then sentiment analysis is carried out. The stages in conducting sentiment analysis in this study are data preprocessing, data processing, classification, and evaluation. The nave Bayes method is used because it has a high level of accuracy in classifying sentiments. Combining it with the lexicon can add precision to organizing emotions compared to other methods. The data used in this study were 4059 data with the distribution of 70% training data and 30% test data. Sentiment analysis obtained in this research shows that Twitter users in Indonesia give more negative comments. This study shows that by using both methods and testing using RapidMiner, the level of accuracy for classifying positive and negative sentiments achieves entirely satisfactory results, namely 82.06%, where the accuracy is higher than using only the lexicon-based saka method by 80%.

articleTitle: Recommendation On Drugs Prescription For Diabetic Patient Using Case based Reasoning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: As medical workers, we are often required to be maximal in treating patients. The knowledge possessed by medical personnel, in this case, doctors, must be demanded to the maximum so that there are no errors in providing treatment to patients. Therefore we need a system to minimize the mistakes, namely a recommendation system. So this study builds a drug recommendation system for patients who have diabetes. One method applied in a recommendation is Case Base Reasoning (CBR). The CBR method calculates based on the similarity of the old case to the new issue. In calculating the similarity of the problems using the Nearest Neighbors algorithm. Although there have been many studies on drug recommendations, no studies have added risk factor variables. Risk factors can influence results more accurately. The results of this study are in the form of a prescription drug recommendation system for diabetic patients based on the type of diabetes they suffer from. They are testing the accuracy of this system using the Confusion Matrix with an accuracy of 80.60%. Suggestions for further research are to add several types of similarity. It is necessary to research different kinds of diseases. It is expected to produce an integrated system that can provide drug recommendations for various conditions.

articleTitle: Utilization of the Gamification Method on the Website Journal System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: In the era of the Industrial Revolution 4.0, technological advances are very important in two areas of publishing educational journals. In science, scientific research is the most important symptom of scientific publications. Today, scientific publications undergo very significant changes. Journal publishing platform or commonly called journal publishing is a journal service system container that is used to disseminate information about scientific research data through the Open Journal System (OJS). One application of gamification techniques in journal publications can be applied to the display board. Due to gamification, users or researchers become more motivated because of the points collected. Display becomes more informative and attractive so that research indicators increase. Users or researchers can also find out information or journals that are often read by other users.

articleTitle: Microservices Architecture As a Data Governance Tools in Decentralized E-Government
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Electronic government, or e-Government, is the use of information and communication technology by the public sector (ICT). Additionally, it can be viewed as a paradigm shift in terms of how governments operate. The government protects public values, while citizens act as problem solvers, co-creators, and active participants in value creation. On the other hand, decentralized systems have grown in popularity over the last few years. Data has become a significant issue in decentralized E-Government; each local entity has their own data, which is private. A suitable data governance tool is required to ensure that data governance is properly implemented and to prevent the organizational entity from leaking information. The purpose of this research is to examine the data governance tools mechanism utilizing microservices.

articleTitle: Mapping Garbage Dump and Landfill in DKI Jakarta Using GIS (Geographic Information System) Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Garbage is one of the complex problems and is very difficult to eliminate. Waste is a problem both in developed countries and developing countries such as Indonesia. In Indonesia itself, the problem of waste often arises because of the inadequacy of waste collection sites such as TPA (Final Shelter) and TPS (Temporary Shelter). This study discusses how to visualize TPS distribution in the DKI Jakarta area using GIS (Geographic Information System) technology to identify which areas have inadequate TPS facilities using the proximity analysis method, namely the buffering process to determine the radius of an area. In this paper, a multi-ring buffer will implement with TPS data to see the coverage area of TPS. TPA estimates the distance a garbage truck travels for 1 hour to reach the TPA area, then packaged in a web-based application called JakartaBersih. From the research conducted by the author, it can be concluded that in several districts in DKI Jakarta, such as Kalideres, Kembangan, Cilandak, Cipayung, there is still a lack of TPS facilities or TPS has not been registered.

articleTitle: Problematic Internet Use and Analysis Factor Affecting with Multiple Regression
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to find out factors affecting toward problematic internet use. The factor is life satisfaction and loneliness. Therefore, the researcher uses a quantitative approach with causal relationship method. The sampling technique used is purposive sampling and number of sample of 348 respondents who meet the criteria between aged 13 to 15 years old and access the internet from gadgets. The research instrument used to measure problematic internet use measured using the Problematic Internet Used Questionnaire 9 (PIUQ-9) and to measure Life satisfaction is using the Multidimensional Student Life Satisfaction Scale (MSLSS), Furthermore Loneliness is measured using the De Jong Loneliness Scale. The validity test of the measuring instrument is confirmatory factor analysis with hypothesis testing is multiple regression analysis. This study produced a significant influence between life satisfaction and loneliness variables on problematic internet use by 57.2%. Based on the results of hypothesis testing are two variables that have a significant effect on problematic internet use, namely friend satisfaction and emotional loneliness. One of psychological intervention program internet use for youth can help adolescents to decreased problematic internet use is Cognitive Behavior Therapy (CBT). The model suggests that problematic cognitions and behavior in adolescence.

articleTitle: Engineering Research Impact in Developing Countries
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: The need to measure the quality of research and its impact on society and the economy is a very important step for justifying research spending. Although there is no particular checklist to evaluate research impact, it is almost agreed that “worth spending” research is the one that contributes to the advancement of knowledge, economy, and social gains. Despite the difficulty of setting definite indicators for each specific impact, there exist some parameters, which can be used as guides to evaluate research impacts. Low-income countries, developing countries, usually have a limited budget for research, and therefore they have to be more careful and wise when spending on research. This paper reviews engineering and science, research impact evaluation in NSF (The National Science Foundation in the USA), EPSRC (Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council in the UK). This paper is attempting to emphasize that developing countries need to consider revising their impact of research to match their national needs and circumstances. The paper also presented a list of indicators, which could be used to develop a comprehensive measurement system for research impact that suits individual developing countries. Finally, the paper encourages developed countries and the global scientific community, to facilitate improvement of research impact in developing countries.

articleTitle: Modeling the Amount of Poverty in Central Java using Geographically Weighted Regression
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Poverty is a current condition faced by the world and Indonesia. According to the Indonesian Central Bureau of Statistics (BPS), in 2020, poor people in Java Island will reach more than 30%. As one province in Java Island, Central Java gets the number of poverties 11.84%. The data given shows that Indonesia still suffers from poverty. In this study, researchers will analyze the result using the Geographically Weighted Regression (GWR) and predict the number of poverties in Central Java. The prediction model was used to predict 35 districts or cities in Central Java with data provided in 2020. As a result, Brebes district became the district as poorest in Central Java; meanwhile, Magelang city with the lowest number of poor people in Central Java. The number of poverties in Central Java is affected by unemployment. Crime actions and number of social welfares.

articleTitle: The application of unsupervised learning techniques to the clustering method in use of cell phones in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: The research objective was to apply unsupervised learning techniques by comparing several clustering methods in data mining to determine the best method for cell phone use cases in Indonesia. The data source comes from the Central Bureau of Statistics with the website url https://www.bps.go.id/. The data category used is the percentage of the population using cellular phones by province from 2012–2018 (34 records). The attributes used are the name of the province, the percentage (%) of the population using cellular telephones in urban areas and the percentage (%) of the population using cellular phones in rural areas. The unsupervised learning methods compared were k-medoids and k-means using the T - Test validity test based on the Davies Bouldin Index (DBI) to evaluate the cluster model. The analysis process uses Rapid Miner software. The mapping label is in the form of the cluster used, namely the high cluster (K1) for cellular phone use and the low cluster (K2) for cellular phone use. The best mapping result for the use of cell phones in urban areas is the k-medoids method with the T - Test result = 0.526 (DBI with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{k}=2$</tex>) where 26 provinces <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathbf{K}1=\mathbf{cluster}_{-}1)$</tex> and 8 provinces <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathbf{K}2\ =\mathbf{cluster}_{-}0)$</tex> • Meanwhile, the best mapping result for the use of cellular phones in rural areas is the k-medoids method with the results of T - Test <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$=0.431$</tex> (DBI with k <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$=2)$</tex> where 31 provinces <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathbf{K}1=\mathbf{cluster}_{-}0)$</tex> and 2 provinces (K2 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$= \mathbf{cluster}_{-}1)$</tex>. Based on the mapping results, the mastery of cellular telephones in rural areas (2 %) and in urban areas (24 %) means that the understanding of the use of cellular telephones in Indonesia is very good. Overall, the k-medoid method is better at mapping cases of cell phone use in Indonesia. Based on the results, it is expected to be information for the government considering that Indonesia has the opportunity to grow very fast and large with the support of the government so that Indonesia's digital industry can overcome the lag behind other countries.

articleTitle: Jakarta Strategic Housing Using Overlay
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: To have a strategic home, people need to observe the environment where they want to live, either in urban or rural areas, increasing simultaneously with population growth, especially in a large metropolitan city like Jakarta, the capital of Indonesia. With problems such as flood and traffic congestion, people living in Jakarta face the complicated problem of choosing the most strategic location for their houses. Due to these problems, this research would create a website containing geospatial information that shows a map of the most strategic locations for housing in Jakarta. The purpose of helping people finds the most strategic locations for them to build or buy a house. To get a map of the most strategic house in Jakarta, we will use the overlay method on flood area, Trans Jakarta station, school, and health facility data. An overlay is a process for the relation between 2 or more data with the same area. For example, overlay Trans Jakarta station data, school station data, health facility data, and flood area data will be merged, and look for which areas overlap with all the data. This research shows that some areas in Jakarta indeed are in a strategic place, like Kebon Jeruk, Sawah Besar, Senen, and Pademangan.

articleTitle: Analyzing Poverty Rate Using ANOVA in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Poverty is one of the major problems in most countries around the world, especially Indonesia. Many factors have caused poverty, such as low education level, low rate of income, and inequality. Based on the data from BPS Indonesia, the poverty rate in 2012 was 11.96% over the population and the poverty rate in 2020 was 9.84% over the population. Based on the data, the government has successfully decreased the poverty rate in Indonesia. This study is trying to analyze the poverty rate in Indonesia from 2012–2020 using ANOVA to look at the difference in the poverty rate from provinces and years as the subject whether the poverty rate in Indonesia is actually decreasing or not before the pandemic. The result showed the poverty rate in Indonesia is not change from 2012–2020 based on years by using one-way ANOVA. The result showed that F value is 0.877 and p-value is 0.535. The p-value is greater than <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$a$</tex> = 0.05 then do not reject H0. It showed that there is no difference between years in the poverty rate. If the result used the province as the subject in one-way ANOVA, it showed a significant differences between poverty rates in the provinces. Because the F value is 737.4 and p-value < 2 x 10-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</sup>• Then p-value is less than 0.05. It means that H0 is rejected. It can be concluded that the poverty rate in each province is different. It can be concluded that the poverty rate in Indonesia did not change significantly in 9 years. But the result of two way ANOVA showed that the year, province and interaction between year and province are significant. It means that the difference between year and province is impacting the poverty rate in Indonesia.

articleTitle: Paper Recommendation for Research References in Data Mining using Content-Based Filtering
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: The recommendation system predicts items that can identify and provide high-potential content selected by the user based on the filtering information. In this study, a reference recommendation system was made to recommend reading papers for students in their final project. This system makes it easier for students to find the correct absolute assignment reading reference according to the topic taken. This study uses the content-based filtering method and the TF -IDF algorithm to find the availability of existing content. Previous studies have researched reading recommendations for students working on their final project using the Collaborative filtering method. The method requires a rating parameter to recommend something so that if there is a new item, the item is not recommended. However, there is a possibility that the thing from each content is similar. Therefore, this research will answer this problem by creating a recommendation system using Content-Based Filtering. After implementation, we tested the accuracy by dividing the test data and training data differently. System testing is done by using a confusion matrix. The results that have been tested get an accuracy of 78%. Further research suggests adding paper data and themes in recommending reading references to make the recommendations more optimal.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Model Comparison for Dense Building Segmentation in the City Using Aerial Imagery Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: City administrations in many developing counties, particularly in high-density cities, have expressed concern about automatic building identification as a foundation for urban growth planning and other reasons. Deep learning has gotten much attention in recent years as the most appealing technique to solve challenges in remote sensing. Semantic picture segmentation, which endeavors to classify each picture element into a collection of provided labels, is one use of deep learning. The purpose of this experiment is intended to assess the use of UNet and PSPNet models. Both models are utilized to recognize dense structures of city centres, which each pixel photo classifies as building or non-building label using deep learning. Based on DKI's research using aerial photographic pictures from the Pasar Minggu Subdistrict in the South Jakarta City Regency. The average accuracy for the Jakarta Provincial model in training was 85%.

articleTitle: The Use of Technological Devices: A Descriptive Study of Students in University
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: In the globalization era of 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century, the most prominent technology development is the technology of communication and information. The development and modernity of the technology of communication and information creates various changes in technology, starting from computer which then changed into gadget form of laptop or notebook, house phone, mobile phone, laptop and iPad. The development of device connected to Internet becomes more needed in daily life, both in socialization and education activity since it significantly affects people's life. Advanced and various technology media can be accessed through Internet by everyone and anywhere. Advanced technology and information causes faster distribution of information. Information can be accepted from one place to another place in almost the same time at different places. The information technology tools that can be used are computer, smartphone, mobile phone and other gadgets that have Internet connection. For people, especially students who belong to the teenagers group, Internet social media is a primary need, which makes the users will always access social media without any absent day.

articleTitle: Combining Classification and Recommendation Techniques on Selecting New Branch Office: A Case of Heavy Equipment Services Company
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: PT. Mustwill is a company engaged in heavy equipment repair services. The number of consumers outside the city or island causes the repair time to take a long time, therefore PT. Mustwill needs a new branch to reduce repair time. In opening a new branch, several things must be considered, such as the number of consumers in each city, income in each city, the area of the shophouse land, the area of the shophouse building, and the price for the shophouse rental. This study uses the Naive Bayes method and the Simple Additive Weighting method. The Naive Bayes method is used to classify feasible or feasible cities in determining the location of new branch openings. In contrast, the simple additive weighting method is used for ranking based on the criteria weighting values of cities that are declared eligible by the Naive Bayes method. Although there have been studies that have used these two methods, no studies have used these two methods to determine recommendations for opening new branches. After implementing, we conducted an accuracy test to test the merging of the two methods for recommendations for opening new branches. Accuracy testing was carried out using rapidminer with an accuracy of 83%. Suggestions for further research are to add several criteria such as population, street names, and coordinates so that the results of the recommendations are more specific.

articleTitle: The Effect of Using Scrabble Mobile Phone Games to Develop Students' Vocabulary Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: The purpose of this research was to obtain empirical evidence on the effect of using scrabble mobile phone games to develop students' vocabulary knowledge. In this research, a quantitative method was chosen, and it was modified into a quasi-experimental study with multiple choices as the instrument of this research. Students from the seventh grade of a junior high school in Jakarta were chosen through purposive sampling as the sample from the research population. 60 students were divided into two classes. 30 students from VII A were selected as the controlled class, and 30 students from VII C were selected as the experimental class. The data were collected from the result of the pre-test and post-test of both classes. According to Setyawarno, the data was analyzed using a normality-test then proceeded with a homogeneity-test to conduct a T-test. The study found a difference in the mean score of the two classes from the post-test result, in which the experimental class got a higher score than the controlled class. The post-test result of the experimental class was 77.67, while the post-test result of the controlled class was 80.93. Moreover, the study found that the T-observation was 13.509, and the T-table with df 58 insignificant level degree of freedom 5% was 1.67. The data result proved that T-observation is higher than T-table., indicating that the null hypothesis (H0) was rejected and alternative hypothesis (Ha) was accepted. Thus, it proved that using scrabble mobile phone games was effective at a moderate level to develop students' vocabulary knowledge.

articleTitle: Blockchain Technology - Emerging Research Themes Opportunities in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: In the industrial era 4.0, technological development is quite rapid, which can be seen from the development that is all with the system. One of which is the Blockchain system. Blockchain is a digital system that stores all transaction records in a ledger. Blockchain technology systems opportunities in research are relevant because they observe the perceived impact and potential disruptions that arise but are slow to generate significant momentum in the information systems literature. This study uses a literature review method that develops the main themes of blockchain technology research with a comprehensive review. This literature analysis highlights that although some commercial-grade blockchain applications currently exist, the technology also provides significant potential for benefit in several cases in higher education use. This study highlights the points by articulating the themes to develop a detailed account of the many blockchain applications and addresses the barriers to blockchain adoption. This study aims to contribute to several UN Sustainability Development Goals in the world of higher education.

articleTitle: Future Energy Using Blockchain Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: A fundamental shift is underway from electrical en-ergy to renewable energy. Renewable energy sources are beyond the push and simple decentralization of the electricity market. This transfer process is based on the energy sector's relationship between old technology and new technology. It connects it with other sectors, such as information and communication technology (ICT), so that it can be reached by technology transfer carried out by information technology players into the market. Blockchain technology is playing a vital role in this shift by offering a decentralized system and an alternative approach to the current organizational form of the energy market. This paper describes the role of blockchain systems in the energy sector, which is described using the term “energy blockchain.” In this study, this research aims to utilize blockchain energy that includes and passes through all aspects by looking at organizations that emphasize the interrelationship of technical dimensions and social dimensions in the energy sector based on the benefits and princi-ples of blockchain for energy trading, information storage, and or increasing transparency of energy flows and energy service. In the following chapters, the authors provide an overview of the current changes in the electricity market, a discussion of the different possible uses for blockchain technology in the energy sector, and a discussion of the barriers and potentials of blockchain energy using different learning perspectives. Finally, the possible opportunities and risks of blockchain energy are discussed. Worldwide significance is mainly based on an integrated world-view-several views are brought together to provide electricity capacity to countless buyers using a predefined global, public and local organization as power transmission: grid power. To impact this course, educational partners and blockchain energy experts need to get further imaginative work together with grounded execution and application in local settings, showing the utility and performance of thoughts before long key accomplices and pioneers. From a specific and IT perspective, this incorporates, specifically, contemplating the possibility of” security by the plan.” Online security is a subject that ought not to be disre-garded, particularly in the blockchain energy field.

articleTitle: Blockchain Technology in the Public Sector by Leveraging the Triumvirate of Security
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Blockchain technology has become a trend in various sectors, both industrial and public sectors. There have been many questions regarding this blockchain technology in terms of competition in the public sector. Mainly among these are the concerns that become issues around governance and control in distributed ledgers. From an information security point of view this article investigates the influence of blockchain technology on public domain processes. It contains an outline of the development of the provision of public services and one-way information by the government to the community, the exchange of information and communication between the public and the government through the current blockchain application, and the current development of blockchain technology. We use a triad, Confidentiality-Integrity-Accessibility to guide our discussion of the interrelationships of security, operation, and regulation of this generation. By leveraging the triad model, we offer a framework for public managers who may also be able to recommend blockchain technology, and we observe the positive benefits that arise from the denial of a distributed ledger. In particular, we look at the benefits of blockchain technology which has to do with disclaimers to help public managers understand how to leverage blockchain generation for an application process.

articleTitle: Boosting E-Service Quality of Online Product Businesses Through It Leadership
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Boosting e-Service Quality of online product businesses is dependent on the mapping of application portfolios of IT services. Nonetheless, implementing procedures, systems, and mechanisms to manage IT resources is still partial, unspecific. To be precise, they are still a part of inappropriate work units. This study intended to find out and ascertain the extent to which IT leadership was required and had positive, significant influences on e-Service Quality improvement. A survey and a convergent triangulation method with an explanatory design through a follow-up explanation model were applied. Questionnaires were completed by 97 leaders and the management selected from the total population of family companies running online product businesses. All data was collected and processed with Likert Scales. An analysis tool named SEM-PLS was utilized. FGDs with 5 key informants were further conducted. Outcomes show that the management ability of family companies to empower IT resources is absent. This scientific proof is reinforced by the incompatibility of IT leadership with digital capability to boost e-Service Quality despite very significant digital orientation. There is a negative value found here.

articleTitle: Utilizing The Potential Of Blockchain Technology For Leading Education 4.0
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Blockchain is the development of a digital data system connected to cryptography, where bitcoin and cryptocurrencies do not escape their use. From the revolutionary era of blockchain technology development, now blockchain technology is widely applied in various fields such as banking, services, entrepreneurship and so on. Therefore this research will lead to the world of education which is one that was applied in the development of previous blockchain technology and will continue to be developed, the great potential of blockchain technology in education will continue to be used to solve problems in the world of education. The result of this research is data that is blockchain in the website framework and has a novelty in the form of blockchain implementation on aid proposals and diploma certificates at universities. This research method uses 2 methods, namely: literature study method and descriptive method. With full hope that this blockchain technology can help in terms of high security in the world of education.

articleTitle: Blockchain iLearning Platform in Education
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: The development of technology is currently growing very rapidly, especially in education where there is currently an ilearning system. i-learning is a learning process that utilizes electronic media in the form of computers and networks as a means to exchange information. But in this case data security is minimal, which makes it easy for data to be widely circulated. Blockchain is a set of data records maintained by a group of computers that do not belong to a single entity. A computer command that facilitates an agreement between one party and another without going through a third party is a Smart Contract. In this study, the existence of Blockchain and smart contracts that will be carried out can bring a level of security and transparency to the ilearning platform. Platform Learning blockchain-based will be developed to improve evaluation and facilitate curriculum personalization in an educational context. Focused on the platform to be able to automate evaluation and credential issues and to demonstrate the benefits of the blockchain backend to end users such as college students and university students. To collect data using the application of the SUS method with sampling which gets a data sample value of 93 and has a SUS score of 75, it shows that the blockchain platform for education is included in the Acceptable category.

articleTitle: Conscious Fog and Electricity Computing Performance: Renewable Energy Case Study
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Fog computing is a highly advantageous computing paradigm for delay, duration, and application-sensitive areas. The features mentioned above make fog computing highly customizable interfaced between the NS Internet of things (IoT) and the Cloud. Although the implementation, layout, modeling, computing, communications, and some architecturally demanding situations, the overall appearance, and power of recently realized Fog-Computing IoT has not achieved significant interest with the help of researchers. To that stop, this paper implies the notion of renewable power inexperienced in fog environments. So, by effectively adding authentication and a layer of security to this sensitive information, blockchain delivers an ideal answer for securing a centralized ledger of utilization statistics. Blockchain generation to be easy to use and has the nature of a mobile platform being a perfect candidate to take full advantage of system capabilities. Adaptive performance and power-aware schemes are the proposals of this paper for the IoT-fog computing environment. To assess the effectiveness of our proposed technique, simulations were configured via the iFogSim simulator, and the results were compared with state-of-the-art cutting-edge methods. This proposed scheme is also officially confirmed for the protection homes. The experimental results show that the extensive playing scheme is better than the comparison method in electricity intake in power saving mode. Furthermore, each power-saving mode and conservative mode from the very good of the proposed scheme defined its efficacy in terms Quality of Service (QoS).

articleTitle: Observation of The Use of Renewable Energy Charging Infrastructure in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: To accommodate the rapid adoption of the commu-nity to new types of transportation, namely electric vehicles whose demand is increasing rapidly, the need for reliable charging materials has increased. In addition, alternative energy sources such as wind and solar energy become needed to help sustain the supply of local electricity grids that are under pressure and need support abundant and cheap alternative energy systems, excellent and affordable alternative energy systems are supposed to help provide energy. Hi, current electricity needs. Therefore, this new refueling station has emerged globally for being praised for being innovative based on renewable energy. Looking at the development of studies related to this type of alternative refueling, We wrote our observations on studies related to alternative refueling in this paper. Resources, potential, planning, control, and pricing are areas of comprehensive research that we present in this paper. Methods such as the appropriate load arrangement of the interval system on storage and control methods on design management and others will be discussed in the article. They will focus on controlling resources that will address the problems that previous research has had. And learning and clarifying the challenges faced and providing suggestions for solutions that meet the challenges regarding this study are also part of the observations we made in this paper. Providing an understanding and overview of this study is our goal in creating this paper so that readers can better understand this study more deeply and build the foundation for further research on this field. Providing solutions to be able to create charging resources that can utilize renewable resources more efficiently and develop use in the community is the goal of this research.

articleTitle: Durability Prediction Model of Reflector Material Against Solar Energy in Corrosive Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Concentrated solar energy technology plays an essential role in today's energy turnarounds. Face our society. The energy generated by this technology is highly dependent on the optical behavior of the reflector material of the solar cell. Corrosion of solar reflectors can be a problem in areas with high corrosion levels Severe environments, such as excessive corrosion of solar mirrors can have a devastating impact on the feasibility of centralized solar thermal systems. This study focuses on modeling the shelf life of four different things. Sunlight reflective material exposed outdoors by accelerated deterioration test. For this purpose, ten suitable locations to concentrate solar thermal applications were classified according to their corrosive aggression. Commercially available free leed and low-cost reflector samples were exposed everywhere to determine the effect of corrosion on durability. Corrosion defects on the solar reflector during outdoor exposure Reproduced correctly in the CASS test. A new life prediction model has been developed for all solar reflectors Depending on the corrosive aggression of the place. Number and thickness of paint layers used in Solar mirrors are recognized as essential parameters for improving energy production. Identified CSP system in a corrosive environment. Expected to reduce capital investment in purchasing solar mirrors For places with low corrosiveness.

articleTitle: Educational Data Mining: The Application in The University's Feedback Survey Analysis using Classification and Clustering Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: XYZ University is one of the private universities that has a commitment to improve its education and institution quality is through the feedback from students. The current method to extract information from the results of student feedback is not sufficient to provide significant knowledge for the University. Currently, the feedbacks are obtained through student surveys are in the form of Open-finished Question (OEQ) and Closed-finished Question (CEQ). The survey itself is divided into two: Student Feedback Questionnaire (SFQ) and Facility Feedback Questionnaire (FFQ). The main goal of this research is therefore to process all of the data from the SFQ and FFQ using classification and clustering techniques for Educational Data Mining (EDM) in order to produce critical information for the decision makers in the University. In addition, this research utilizes order methods to foresee the viewpoint mark of the overview in the open-finished poll. The result of the research shows that the best multi class grouping model for SFQ is utilizing the SVM calculation with the assessment normal score of 69.82%. Concerning the FSQ, the best multi name order model is determined utilizing the SVM calculation and the classifier chain as the best library multi mark with the assessment normal score of 73.325%. This exploration is likewise utilizing bunching strategies for gathering the CEQ review respondent. Concerning SFQ, the best grouping model is obtained from the K-Means calculation with the assessment normal score of 0.582. In the interim, concerning the FSQ, the best bunching model is obtained from the Fuzzy C Means calculation with an assessment normal score of 0.586. (Abstract) Keywords─

articleTitle: Design Approach in Conference Management System with EZDESK Dashboard for Digital Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Conference management system is a concept for handling and managing relevant file in various activities simultaneously before and after the conference. Actually, the preparation activities at the conference are involving the administrative processes recorded. In this case, the direction and modeling process should consider the user experience (UX) through a simplified design approach to RMS (recognize, materialize and scrutinize), which has been designed to help the development of prototype with standards and usability aspects that align with user requirements as an important factor and motivates overall implementation. EzDesk is an application designed to assist users in application registration and verification of conference registration documents. Meanwhile, a digital ecosystem is a group of interconnected IT resources that can function as a single unit. It consists of suppliers, customers, business partners, applications, third-party data service providers and all their technologies, whose interoperability is the key to the success of the ecosystem.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Microservices Architecture with GraphlQL as an API Gateway for Higher Education Information System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: The use of monolithic architecture is considered ineffective for use in large-scale applications because it can affect the complexity of further development. In addition, the use of monolithic architecture allows failure of part of the system that can affect the entire system, so that the application must be fully maintained. Microservices is an architecture built by separating component parts (services) that do not depend on each other and have their respective functions. Each service can communicate and is managed by an API gateway that implements GraphQL as a data communication protocol. The method of decomposition of the system into service is carried out by applying the Decomposition by business capability pattern method. In this study, the authors recommend the use of a new system architecture for Academic Information System on UIN Jakarta based on literature studies from existing research. The result of this research is an analysis and architectural design of microservices with GraphQL as the API Gateway for the academic information system of UIN Jakarta for student.

articleTitle: Syslog Episode Mining for Tracking Behavior in SCADA servers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: It is important to assess the reliability of software upgrades and patches applied regularly to servers within SCADA systems. This paper introduces a top-down approach to characterize the degree of similarity between sets of episodes arising from server logs. Filtered sub-logs of syslog data are mined to check whether they contain base episodes. Subsequently higher-level compound episodes are mined, wherein multiple base episodes are composed into compound episodes, from possibly different source programs. A tracking score is used to assess changes in the similarity of the syslog over time-periods. Unexpected changes in tracking scores could indicate potential reliability concerns. Episode mining is suggested as a method to obtain the rules by which invariant-checking could be implemented, to continuously monitor a SCADA system's reliability during operation.

articleTitle: A Nomographic Tool for Evaluating The Hosting Capacity of Photovoltaic Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: The proliferation of solar photovoltaic generation in low-voltage distribution networks has resulted in a series of challenges in the operation and control of the network. The rise in voltage and current from the solar photovoltaic system has become the main concern for low-voltage grids. Along with this, there is a growing need for generic equipment. Furthermore, utilities can use to handle customer demands for new solar Photovoltaic connections. This paper proposes a generic approach to assessing solar photovoltaic hosting capacity subject to overvoltage restriction. The approach facilitates valuable, the solar photovoltaic connection criteria was developed using the Nomogram representation based on the evaluation of hosting capacity

articleTitle: Doctors Dynamic Scheduling For Outpatient, Inpatient, And Surgery Using Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Doctor scheduling and rescheduling play an essential factor in the day-to-day operation of the hospital. It is essential in scheduling suitable Doctors to provide the best service to patients with optimized resources. Rescheduling a doctor is unrecognized as an everyday time-consuming management task with different imperatives from scheduling. Poor rescheduling decisions can have quality, cost, and moral implications. This study aims to develop a genetic algorithm that can assist in scheduling and rescheduling doctors for medical resources. Our case study is classified as a re-planning problem using the genetic algorithm method in treating physician scheduling and rescheduling for outpatient, inpatient, and surgery. An integer permutation representation with 200 chromosomes is used, where each digit in the gene represents the work program. The crossover method used is Two-point crossover, reciprocal exchange mutation method, and elitism selection. The tests' results include a population size of 50 individuals with an average fitness of 0.4766667, 100 generations with an average fitness of 0.5, and the combination of Cr = 0.20 and Mr 0.80 with an average fitness of 0.48. the genetic algorithm can combine further research with a Hybrid Tabu Search Algorithm, Bee Colony Optimization Algorithm, and Harmony search algorithm (HSA) to produce an optimal schedule solution.

articleTitle: Warehouse Receipt System using Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) for Agricultural Islamic Financing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Islamic banks are expected to be able to fully contribute to the availability of agricultural sector financing with ease of requirements and guarantees for farmers who need additional working capital for their farming businesses through user-friendly applications. Islamic banks also need other supporting institutions, such as guarantee institutions that are authorized to issue collateral in the form of Warehouse Receipts (WRS), start-up companies for marketing agricultural products, internet technology for information on the feasibility of farmers' businesses, and others. The TAM method is used to measure farmers' perceptions of the usefulness and ease of use of Internet-based WRS guarantee for agricultural financing with a sample of 193 respondents consisting of farmers and Islamic bank employees in the financing section. The results of the analysis show that the direct effect of usefulness and ease of use on usage attitude is positive, strong and significant, as well as behavioral intentions of use and actual system usage. But the direct effect of usefulness and ease of use on behavioral intention of use is positive, weak and insignificant. The direct effect of ease of use on the actual system usage has a positive, strong and significant. The indirect effect of usefulness and ease of use on the actual system usage through usage attitudes is positive, strong and significant, but through behavioral intentions of use, the effect is positive, weak and insignificant. It means that farmers have expectations in this Internet-based WRS guarantee for agricultural Islamic financing product. However, Islamic banks indicate an uncertain perception.

articleTitle: The effect of digital storytelling to foster students' Speaking ability in describing people
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: The focus of this study was to capture empirical evidence on the effect of Digital Storytelling (DST) on students' speaking ability in describing people, and also to measure the effect size provided by DST. In this study, a quantitative method was utilized, and it was designed as a quasi-experimental study with oral tests as the instrument. Students from the seventh grade of an Islamic-based junior high school in Jakarta were selected using purposive sampling as the subjects for this study. The total number of students was 56, with 28 students from VII F (experimental class) and 28 students from VII G (control class). The data was gathered using the students' pre-test and post-test scores. The next step was data analysis by using a T-test formula from Sudijono[1], which was calculated using SPSS 20. The study found that the experimental class's post-test mean score was 76.71, while the controlled class's post-test mean score was 72.14. This revealed that the average value of the experimental class exceeded the control class. The T-test showed that tobservation was 2.627 and ttable with df 54 was 1.674 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(1.674\ <\ 2.627)$</tex>, indicating that H0 (Null Hypothesis) was rejected and Ha (Alternative Hypothesis) was accepted. With d= 0,35, DST had a medium effect on the measurement of effect size level. As a result, using Digital Storytelling was effective in fostering students' speaking ability in describing people.

articleTitle: Analyzing Sentiments on Indonesia's New National Palace using The Combination of Naive Bayes and Sentiment Scoring
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: Sentiment Analysis is one of the fields of Natural Language Processing (NLP) that builds a system to recognize and extract opinions in text form with the help of sentiment analysis; previously unstructured information can be changed to be more structured. There are many ways to implement sentiment analysis, one of which is to use the Naive Bayes method to categorize a word and sentence from a sentiment. To determine a sentiment, we need a technique that helps to calculate the negative and positive of a sentence. The method used is sentiment scoring. This research begins by mining the required data, namely the pre-design of the state palace, pre-processing of data with four stages of case folding, tokenizing, stopword, and stemming. Sentiment scoring produces positive and negative labels, and then Naive Bayes is used to entering each category. According to the criteria. The next stage is to implement a sentiment analysis system that has been designed previously for the state palace and ends with the testing stage. Although several studies have been conducted related to sentiment analysis, none have used sentiment assessment for labeling. After implementation, we tested the accuracy by dividing the test data and training data differently. The test is carried out using a fast mining tool. The results obtained an accuracy of 70%, and the effects of sentiment on this issue are 28.57% positive and 71.43% negative. This means that public sentiment towards the design of the new capital city is the number of criticisms that come out. Some provide criticism by providing input, do not support it, though, and provide support briefly. Suggestions for further research are to add and use a better sentiment dictionary and expand case studies on the government to get high accuracy results.

Author Keywords: Pre Design Of State Of Place

articleTitle: Exchange Parameters For Limiting Efficiency Of Back-Emitting Passive Silicon Solar Cells Contact
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: There has been a developing interest in solving the different technical problems that Emitting Passive Silicon Solar cell contact (EPSc) through process optimization including chemical polishing, dielectric passivation and contact geometry etc. In this contribution, a detailed investigation on recombination and resistive losses at rear surface of EPSc solar cells using advanced imaging techniques for spatial distribution and allied characterization approaches are performed for better understanding of loss mechanisms and possible routes for their mitigation. Our investigation that spreading resistance <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathrm{R}_{spr})$</tex> and the converse immersion current thickness through the principal diode <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathrm{J}_{01})$</tex> are the two primary boundaries when estimating the effectiveness increment of EPSc sun based cells. articleTitle: The Use of Electronic Communication Technology by Terrorist Movement in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Science and Technology (ICOSTECH)
abstract: This paper explains the use of electronic communication technology of chat application particularly Telegram for terrorism movement in Indonesia through a terrorist group in Batam called Katibah Gongong Rebus (KGR). Through an interdisciplinary qualitative studies of terrorism studies and communication and technology studies, this article uses communication technology perspective to have better understanding of electronic communication technology of Telegram. From the case of KGR movement through social media of Telegram, it shows the media of communication, the ways of communication, the content of communications, and the relations among the terrorists as well as the links among some terrorist groups in Indonesia. Telegram has been used by them for: 1) recruiting followers, 2) planning actions, 3) communication and coordination among group members, 4) networking and connecting among terrorist groups across countries, and 5) spreading messages. The movement of terrorism becomes more massive through the use of ECT.
